controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE/REGLEMENTAIRE : aucune affirmation d'enquete, poursuite, amende, litige, fraude ou antitrust dans l'ATT CAP.PA. Seule mention reglementaire : sanctions et embargos possibles (URD).
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, chapitre 3.2 : "The consequences of the armed conflict in the Middle East, between Russia and Ukraine, as well as geopolitical tension between the United States and China are monitored internally. In particular, these tensions could lead to new sanctions and embargoes at global level." L'ATT reste au conditionnel comme la source.

controles.affirmation: "le groupe attribue explicitement ce repli [marge France 10,0% -> 7,7%] aux CHARGES DE RESTRUCTURATION Fit-for-Growth, dont les benefices ne se materialiseront que progressivement a partir du second semestre 2026".
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026 : "The operating margin decreased to 7.7% compared to 10.0% last year" - AUCUNE cause n'est donnee pour la France. La seule attribution du communique est generale : "The operating margin expanded in North America and contracted in continental Europe, where the benefits of the Fit-for-Growth initiatives, announced in February 2026, will build progressively from H2 2026." Surtout, la definition maison exclut ces charges : "Operating margin ... is calculated before 'Other operating income and expenses' which include ... restructuring costs incurred under a detailed formal plan approved by the Group's management". Les charges Fit-for-Growth ne peuvent donc PAS faire baisser la marge operationnelle : elles frappent le resultat operationnel (878 M EUR, -10,1%), pas la marge.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "le groupe explique la contraction des marges en Europe continentale par le fait que les benefices du plan Fit-for-Growth ne se materialiseront que progressivement a partir du second semestre 2026". Ne pas ecrire que les charges de restructuration pesent sur la marge operationnelle : par construction elles n'y entrent pas.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #4 (free cash flow organique -38,3% a 37 M EUR ; hausse de ~200 M EUR des decaissements de restructuration en 2026).
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026 : "Organic free cash flow* was EUR 37 million, compared with EUR 60 million for the same period last year" (-38,3%) ; "The organic free cash flow target takes into account an increase in restructuring cash outflow of around EUR 200 million compared to 2025 related to the Fit-for-Growth initiatives."
controles.correction_proposee: Defaut de forme : ce bloc est le seul de fondamental_interne SANS champ "preuve". Ajouter la citation ci-dessus.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 1 : resultat net part du Groupe -31,3% a 498 M EUR ; BPA de base -30,6% a 2,96 EUR ; BPA normalise -11,9% a 5,29 EUR.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026, tableau Key figures : "Net profit (Group share) 724 / 498 / -31.3%" ; "Basic earnings per share (EUR) 4.26 / 2.96 / -30.6%" ; "Normalized earnings per share (EUR)* 6.00 / 5.29 / -11.9%".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 2 : dette nette de 6 454 M EUR au 30/06/2026 contre 2 799 M EUR un an plus tot et 5 306 M EUR fin 2025 ; obligation de 800 M EUR emise en mai 2026 apres remboursement a echeance ; tresorerie de 2,6 Mds EUR.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026 : "Net cash / (Net debt)* (2,799) / (6,454)" ; "the Group's net debt* is EUR 6.5 billion, compared with EUR 5.3 billion as at December 31, 2025, and EUR 2.8 billion at as June 30, 2025" ; "In April 2026, the Group redeemed in full and at maturity its EUR 800 million bond issued in April 2020 and successfully issued new bond in May 2026 for EUR 800 million" ; "At June 30, 2026, Capgemini had cash, cash equivalents and cash management assets of EUR 2.6 billion". Le chiffre exact 5 306 M EUR provient du communique FY2025 ("NET CASH / (NET DEBT) (2,107) (5,306)"), pas du communique S1 2026 qui n'ecrit que "EUR 5.3 billion".
controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter le communique FY2025 comme source du 5 306 M EUR (deja present dans _sources, mais pas rattache a l'affirmation).

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 3 : ETR de 37,5% au S1 2026 contre 26,2% au S1 2025, "que le groupe qualifie lui-meme de non representative du taux annuel".
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026 : "The income tax expense was EUR 305 million in H1 2026, representing an effective tax rate (ETR) of 37.5%, compared to EUR 260 million and 26.2% for the same period last year. This amount includes certain items making the ETR for H1 not necessarily representative of the full year ETR."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le groupe ecrit "NOT NECESSARILY representative", l'ATT durcit en "non representative". Ecrire "pas necessairement representative".

controles.affirmation: Croissance publiee +8,8% contre +11,3% a taux constants, ecart de 2,5 pts entierement d'origine devise ; 4,0 pts au T1 ; contribution inorganique estimee a ~5 points sur un objectif de +8,5 a +9,0% ; France +0,4% et Reste de l'Europe +2,6%.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique S1 2026, tableau de reconciliation : "Growth at constant exchange rates +11.0% / +11.6% / +11.3% ; Exchange rate fluctuations -4.0pts / -1.1pts / -2.5pts ; Reported growth +7.0% / +10.5% / +8.8%" ; Outlook : "Revenue growth of around +8.5% up to +9.0% at constant exchange rates ... The inorganic contribution is estimated at around 5 points (was around 4.5 points to 5 points)" ; tableau regions : France 2,142 / +0.4% / +0.4% ; Rest of Europe 3,506 / +3.1% / +2.6%. France = "19% of 2025 Group revenues".

controles.affirmation: Ratio dette nette / tresorerie disponible d'environ 2,5 fois contre "un quasi-equilibre un an plus tot".
controles.verbatim_source: 6 454 / 2 600 = 2,48. Au 30/06/2025 (rapport financier semestriel 2025, Note 14) : tresorerie nette 2 106 + cash management assets 262 = 2 368 M EUR pour une dette nette de 2 799 M EUR, soit un ratio de 1,18 : "quasi-equilibre" tient.
controles.correction_proposee: Le comparatif 2025 n'a aucune source citee dans l'ATT. Ajouter la Note 14 du rapport semestriel 2025. Reserve de fond : "dette nette / tresorerie" n'est pas un ratio de credit standard (le marche regarde dette nette / EBITDA) ; il gonfle optiquement la degradation.

controles.affirmation: Modele Rightshore : Inde = ~50% de l'effectif total ; conflit arme, sanctions ou embargo pourraient interrompre l'activite ; "The Group's direct exposure to China is low".
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 (23 mars 2026), chapitre 3.2 : "particularly India (which alone accounts for around 50% of the Group's total headcount), Poland, Portugal, Romania, China, Guatemala, Morocco, Tunisia..." ; "these tensions could lead to new sanctions and embargoes at global level" ; "The Group's direct exposure to China is low." Ailleurs le meme URD ecrit "Over half of our workforce are based in India".

controles.affirmation: Risque cyber : verbatims "Elevated cybersecurity concerns in 2025" et "an increasingly challenging and dynamic cyber-environment" ; gouvernance confiee a un membre du comite executif ; trois pages (122 a 124).
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, section c) Security risks / Cyber Risks : "Elevated cybersecurity concerns in 2025 reflect continued growing recognition of a complex cyber risk landscape..." ; "Capgemini is facing an increasingly challenging and dynamic cyber-environment in a world strongly shaped by geopolitical conflicts..." ; "This dedicated governance structure is headed by a member of the Group Executive Board."
controles.correction_proposee: Deux imprecisions : (1) la source dit "Group Executive Board" (Direction Generale de Capgemini), pas "comite executif" - ce sont deux organes distincts chez Capgemini ; ecrire "un membre de la Direction Generale". (2) La pagination "pages 122 a 124" n'est pas verifiable sur l'extraction texte du data-lake ; soit citer le titre de section ("3.2 Risk factors - c) Security risks / Cyber Risks"), soit retirer les numeros de page.
